description: This is a Java interface file defining a repository for User entities, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository and adding a method to find users by email.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for User entities, providing CRUD operations and a custom method to find users by email.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a User entity by its email address, returning an Optional<User>.
